omissions: Preservational distortion should explicitly qualify model inputs, especially dimensions treated as biological limits.
Selection favoured complete, well-preserved specimens with little visible pyrite; the sample cannot define population distributions.
Apiculiretusispora assignment needs its unusual proximal ornamentation caveat. [Morris et al. 2024](https://doi.org/10.37520/fi.2024.012), indexed full-text p. 137.

Boyce’s physiological-dependence hypothesis deserves discussion as a model-based alternative, not an observed life history. [Boyce 2008](https://doi.org/10.1666/0094-8373(2008)034%5B0179:HGWCTI%5D2.0.CO;2), abstract and indexed full-text excerpts.
model_transfer_assessment: The chosen contrasts are appropriate. Transferable observations need a specimen-by-variable mapping: the present architecture bullet mixes its named specimens with an endpoint from another specimen. Most exclusions are sensible, but replace “minimal” with “observed small-axis example”, distinguish shared morphology from anatomical extrapolation, and avoid deriving conducting-file or hydraulic geometry from cell width alone.
overall: The card preserves useful distinctions between observation, interpretation and extrapolation, but needs corrections to specimen attribution, the Kenrick–Crane citation and two modelling statements. This is a partial source audit: inaccessible PDF passages leave several numerical claims unverified, so it does not justify marking the card reviewed.
